lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like matrix of anchor points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and a shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, fusiform biological entities (remoras) distributed along the ventral-lateral interface and a high density of high-luminance backscatter throughout the water column.
